d: Join Charlie, a Korean traveler, as he sets off on a mesmerizing journey through some of Bihar’s most unique and lesser-known destinations in this episode! From serene three river islands to wildlife sanctuaries and spiritual temples, Charlie’s exploration of Kahalgaon, Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary, Nagi Dam Bird Sanctuary, and Lachhuar Shwetambar Jain Temple is a perfect blend of nature, wildlife, and spirituality.
